'''Convergence''' was the ancestral home of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]] in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]]. Located at the end of a vast stretch of meadow beneath mountains overlooking a [[Unidentified Naboo lake|lake]], it was built at some point before c. [[135 BBY/Legends|135 BBY]] in the style of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] buildings. Both [[Cosinga Palpatine]] and his son, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], were raised in Convergence.

==Description==
Convergence was a majestic country house built in the style of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] architecture, incorporating rotund domes and graceful towers, located approximately two hours by [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] from the aforementioned city. A wide flight of stone steps led to a dimly lit, spacious foyer decorated with wall hangings&mdash;including tapestry displaying the [[House Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] crest&mdash;and statuary set on plinths, that ended in a veranda offering a view of [[Unidentified Naboo lake|the lake]] beyond&mdash;including the island of [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]]&mdash;through round-topped, floor-to-ceiling windows. A table overlooking the veranda was used for dining. Stonework predominated in the house, the expensive furniture was constructed of the rarest [[Hardwood/Legends|hardwoods]] in the galaxy, the rooms were decorated with works of art, and the floors were covered with plush carpets. Several servants and security guards worked for the Palpatines in Convergence.<ref name="DPN" />

==History==
According to [[Cosinga Palpatine]], around the year [[135 BBY/Legends|135 BBY]], [[Cosinga Palpatine's grandfather|his grandfather]], after becoming aware of the fact that [[Gungan–Naboo War#Naboo mercenary conflict|the most recent]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] war had been manipulated by [[House Tapalo|Houses Tapalo]], [[House Veruna|Veruna]] and other [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|royals]] seeking to profit from Naboo's [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] reserves, challenged [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo's]] [[Tapalo|father]] to a duel of honor. The duel took place on the Convergence veranda overlooking the lake, and resulted in the death of Cosinga's grandfather.<ref name="DPN" />

In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] traveled to Naboo after learning from members of [[Subtext Mining]] that a massive plasma reserve had been discovered beneath Theed. During his second visit to the planet, Damask and the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] accompanying him were detained by a group of security guards at the spaceport. The Magister was then escorted by [[Palace Guard]]s to Convergence. He was left to wander in the foyer for a while, and then was greeted by Cosinga Palpatine, who gave him a tour of about a dozen of the house's rooms. Afterwards, they dined in the table overlooking the veranda, and Palpatine related the story of his grandfather's duel with Bon Tapalo's father. Veiled threats were exchanged, and the meeting ended with Cosinga Palpatine throwing Damask out of the house.<ref name="DPN" />

After the Palpatine family's unexplained disappearance following their trip to [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila's]] [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] on the [[Palpatine family starship|family]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]&mdash;actually a massacre at the the hands of the eldest son and heir, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;the latter sold the house and moved to a [[Palpatine's Theed apartment|modest apartment]] in Theed.<ref name="DPN" /> Years later, after becoming [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Palpatine maintained a [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|different]] country house on Naboo.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
